g.text: YAKB A0 | NiZ EC + HHKB 6u + nice!nano v2 | ENGINEERING PROTOTYPE

g.desc: YAKB A0 | NiZ EC + HHKB 6u + nice!nano v2 | ENGINEERING PROTOTYPE

g.text: Physical pin numbers and named nets are authoritative. USB is an external passive data extension to U1.

g.desc: Physical pin numbers and named nets are authoritative. USB is an external passive data extension to U1.

g.text: U2/U3: only one INH low at a time. U4 gain 101. DRAIN goes through R32 to SENSE. Q1 gates U4 only.

g.desc: U2/U3: only one INH low at a time. U4 gain 101. DRAIN goes through R32 to SENSE. Q1 gates U4 only.

g.text: SW1/SW2 are 2.54mm solder-hole harnesses. No external 5V connection to U1 BATTERY+.

g.desc: SW1/SW2 are 2.54mm solder-hole harnesses. No external 5V connection to U1 BATTERY+.

g.text: EC electrodes: logical row = physical row; column = floor(x_u + width_u/2), including empty column bins.

g.desc: EC electrodes: logical row = physical row; column = floor(x_u + width_u/2), including empty column bins.
